_note: Facts no source publishes, entered by hand. `doors` adds a locked-room marker for a key whose door has no marker upstream; its label must contain the key's own words so the key page links to it. `items` gives a short where-to-find note for items with no loot area. Each entry says where it came from.

doors.label: Emperor Gateway Conduit Door
doors.source: Marked on the in-game map by Devon, 2026-11-06. Placed from that screenshot using the four transceivers as reference points, so expect it within about 20 m.

insulation-roll.where: Pendola Pass only. Loose on seats, tables and counters in the train carriages, especially at the Railyard; on the shelves of the Snow Shelter that opens during a Flash Freeze; and around Almatera Station, Cielo Sereno Observatory and the Freight Terminal. Not guaranteed, so expect several runs.
insulation-roll.source: Community guides (GamesRadar, GameRant, allthings.how), read 2026-11-06. Not checked in game.

dam-utility-key.where: Opens closets and small utility rooms in the Dam's administration buildings. The exact doors aren't mapped yet.
dam-utility-key.source: Community key list shared by Devon, 2026-11-06.

expired-security-code.where: Opens nothing. A security code becomes this once its raid ends; sell it. Fresh codes print at Pilgrim's Peak, Ancient Fort, Raider's Refuge and Reinforced Reception on the Blue Gate.
